acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: The formula for Coca-Cola is one of the most jealously guarded trade secrets in the world. So we were surprised to find a 1979 newspaper article that might contain Coke's original recipe. We were even more surprised to find reasons to believe the recipe is real.
acts.title: Message In a Bottle

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
Jake Halpern tells this story about document expert John Reznikoff, who came into possession of some materials which — if authentic — would change history. Then, things got complicated
Jake is the host of the podcast Deep Cover, which explores stories about secrets and deceptions.
acts.title: Ask Not What Your Handwriting Authenticator Can Do for You; Ask What You Can Do for Your Handwriting Authenticator
